Name: Better Tappers
Author: CaptainSully
Description:
[size=5]About[/size][b]

Note:[/b] output amounts, time, and quality are decided when the tapper is placed/harvested (this is a vanilla behaviour). So as soon as you harvest a tapper it decides what the next harvest will be, and then presents it at the appropriate time. This means you'll get situations such as you getting the botanist perk or updating your configs and not getting iridium quality or whatever change to outputs you expected until the next harvest, among other things.
[b]
-Output times-[/b]
Configurable output times and output amounts for all vanilla tappable trees.
Also adds the option of planting coconuts to grow palm trees, and makes palm trees tappable (they produce palm oil). Time and amount configurable.
Green rain trees 1 and 2 give moss (#3 gives fern, as vanilla)

Defaults for mahogany is 1 day, and produces 6 sap (vanilla is 3-8, for an average of 5.5)
Defaults for green rain trees (moss or ferns) is 2 days, and produces 1 at a time
Default for all other trees is 7 days, also producing 1 at a time

Note that none of this changes the normal logic for what the next mushroom will be from a mushroom tree.


[b]-Experience-
[/b]You now gain foraging experience for harvesting from tappers! It defaults to 3xp per harvest, which you can set to between 1 and 50 in the configs. If you want to disable this, just set it to 0.


[b]-Quality-[/b]
Tappers can now produce items with quality! There are 3 options to choose from.
﻿"None" which disables quality for tapper outputs; vanilla.
﻿"Foraging Level" which calculates quality for tapper outputs the same way vanilla calculates any other foraged item (max gold quality without botanist).
﻿"Tree Age" which has an accompanying setting, 'Age (days) for quality increase' which is the number of days for quality to increase by 1. By default this is 84 days (3 months), for iridium quality at 252 days (2.25 years).


[b]-Other-
[/b]Support for both the gatherer and botanist foraging perks. Each has it's own option in the config, and they are enabled by default.
Note that if you disable quality in the config, the botanist perk will also stop working.

You can allow mushroom and fern trees to produce in winter, and prevent them from turning into stumps in winter. Both default to true.

Choose whether other nearby trees prevent tree growth. Default is vanilla behaviour. I suggest placing paths if you turn this of, if you don't already.


[size=5]Updating/Installing[/size]
Completed remove any previous version of Better Tappers.
Drop the "BetterTappers" folder into your Mods folder.

You can add or remove Better Tappers from existing saves without issue.
Note that tree age will start at 0 regardless of how old your save is when you install this. This only matters if you want to use that for determining quality.
If you play without the mod and then reinstall it later, tree ages may reset to 0.


[size=5]Compatibility
[/size]Though it isn’t in any way required, as always I recommend you use Generic Mod Config Menu if you intend to play around with the configs.

This will probably be semi compatible with other mods that modify basic tapper or basic wild tree behaviour. BT *shouldn't* throw errors, but it may get confusing if you have multiple mods fighting over the settings.

This works with automate. I assume it will work just as well with other automation mods.

Combine Machines will work as long as its configs have "Tappers" and "Heavy Tappers" set to "MultiplyItems" instead of "IncreaseSpeed"

Major rework.
-Spacecore no longer required
-Support for 1.6 trees BT was missing
-Added/changed numerous options for trees generally, and tappers specifically
-Now two quality options that actually make sense
-Significant behind the scenes changes
